caption: Switch between two screens of a workspace: each one shows at once, with no slide and no fade.

steps.title: Screen 1 shows a build log
cmux:
command=printf '\033]0;Build\007'; clear; printf '
  \033[1;32mBUILD\033[0m

  compile  ok
  link     ok
  sign     ok
'; sleep 900

steps.title: Screen 2 shows notes
cmux:
command=printf '\033]0;Notes\007'; clear; printf '
  \033[1;34mNOTES\033[0m

  - ship the fix
  - write the test
  - call the lab
'; sleep 900
